verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official CLI (documented commands like pulumi preview, pulumi import, pulumi do) that is core to its IaC workflow, and it also integrates with AI-native tooling via an official MCP server and Automation API for programmatic/agentic use. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of CLI's AI-native ergonomics and no dedicated 'AI CLI mode' benchmarking beyond docs.
